body: Major 嚴力行, who is currently studying at the graduate institute of National Defense University's College of Science and Engineering, won first prize in the America's Innovation theme with his photographic work F-22 Fighter Jet in the American Institute in Taiwan's Through the Lens of America photography contest, according to the Military News Agency. The contest was held to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States, with the themes American Stories, Beauty of America, and America's Innovation, inviting the public to share memorable images from travel in the United States. Yen said he developed a strong interest in photography while studying at the Republic of China Military Academy and often went to photograph aircraft during holidays; during a trip to the United States this summer, he specially arranged to visit a local airshow, giving him the opportunity to capture the F-22 in flight.

According to the Military News Agency, Yen's work captured the high-speed flight moment of an F-22 fighter jet dashing out rapidly from dense smoke, accompanied by the exhaust flame from its F119 engine, presenting the jet's power and flight attitude and echoing the technological-breakthrough spirit of the America's Innovation theme. Yen explained that the F-22 is the world's first high-performance stealth fighter, one of the U.S. Air Force's important air-superiority forces, and a demonstration of contemporary aerospace and military technology development. He said he was honored to receive the judges' recognition and hoped to share through photography the beauty of military technology and the feeling of that moment with more people.
en.summary: Major 嚴力行 won first prize in the America's Innovation theme of AIT's Through the Lens of America photography contest with his work F-22 Fighter Jet.
en.title: Taiwan major's F-22 photo wins first prize in AIT photography contest

body: 軍聞社表示，目前於國防大學理工學院研究所進修的少校嚴力行，以作品「F-22戰機」參加美國在台協會為慶祝美國建國250週年舉辦的「鏡頭下的美國」攝影比賽，獲得「美國創新」主題首獎。該比賽另設「美國故事」、「美國之美」主題，邀請民眾分享赴美旅遊的難忘影像。嚴力行表示，他在陸軍官校求學期間培養對攝影的興趣，休假時常前往拍攝飛機；今年夏天赴美旅遊期間，他特別安排參訪當地航空展，因而拍下F-22戰機飛行的珍貴畫面。
據軍聞社描述，作品捕捉F-22戰機自濃煙中高速衝出的瞬間，並伴隨F119引擎的排氣火焰，展現戰機的強大動力與飛行姿態，也呼應「美國創新」主題所傳達的技術突破精神。嚴力行表示，F-22戰機是全球首款高性能匿蹤戰機，也是美國空軍重要的空中優勢戰力，展現當代航太與軍事科技的發展；他很榮幸獲得評審肯定，也希望透過攝影與更多人分享軍事科技之美與當下的感受。

zh.title: 國軍少校嚴力行赴美拍攝F-22戰機，獲AIT攝影比賽首獎
